tools.description: Your own hands. Chest compressions and direct manual pressure.
tools.misuseConsequence: Compressions on a beating heart bruise the myocardium and ribs.

tools.description: Number 10 blade. Primary incisions and sharp division of clamped structures.
tools.misuseConsequence: Cutting an organ or vessel directly opens a bleeder you then have to control.

tools.description: Heavy shears for fast, blunt division of tough tissue and dressings.
tools.misuseConsequence: Crushes delicate structures instead of dividing them cleanly.

tools.description: Fine toothed forceps for tissue handling and removing foreign bodies.
tools.misuseConsequence: A rough grip crushes tissue and starts fresh oozing.

tools.description: Locking clamp for bleeding vessels and for structures about to be divided.
tools.misuseConsequence: Clamping healthy bowel or nerve crushes it permanently.

tools.description: Holds a divided layer open so deeper structures can be reached.
tools.misuseConsequence: Excessive traction tears the wound edge and causes bleeding.

tools.description: Clears blood and fluid so the surgical field stays visible.
tools.misuseConsequence: Pressing the tip into an organ causes suction trauma.

tools.description: Seals small bleeders with heat. Right click cycles the power setting.
tools.misuseConsequence: Burns healthy tissue; sustained high power in an oxygen-rich field starts a fire.

tools.description: Places individual stitches. Right click runs a continuous repair.
tools.misuseConsequence: Bunched or sloppy stitches leak and have to be redone.

tools.description: Fast skin closure. Quicker than suturing, cosmetically worse.
tools.misuseConsequence: Staples driven into deep tissue or organs cause injury and must be removed.

tools.description: Opens the chest once the sternum has been divided.
tools.misuseConsequence: Cranking it open on intact ribs fractures them.

tools.description: Divides bone. Used for sternotomy and debriding shattered fragments.
tools.misuseConsequence: Overshoot goes straight into the heart or lungs behind the sternum.

tools.description: Pilot holes in long bones and burr holes in the skull. Right click drives screws.
tools.misuseConsequence: Plunging through the far cortex damages whatever lies beneath.

tools.description: Right click reduces the fracture, left click seats the plate.
tools.misuseConsequence: Plating an unreduced fracture leaves the limb permanently malaligned.

tools.description: Inserts a camera and opens the video feed on the stack.
tools.misuseConsequence: Pushing the scope blindly perforates whatever is in front of it.

tools.description: Long grasper worked through a port. More reach, far less feel.
tools.misuseConsequence: A blind grasp tears tissue you cannot see.

tools.description: Washes contamination and debris out of the wound, lowering infection risk.
tools.misuseConsequence: Over-irrigating cools the patient toward hypothermia and floods the field.

tools.description: Right click charges and cycles energy, left click delivers the shock.
tools.misuseConsequence: Shocking a non-shockable rhythm wastes time and worsens the arrest.

tools.description: Draws up and pushes drugs. Right click changes drug, mouse wheel sets the dose.
tools.misuseConsequence: A dose outside the therapeutic window causes its own complication.

tools.description: Tube thoracostomy. Right click confirms placement and starts drainage.
tools.misuseConsequence: Driven through lung parenchyma it causes a major air leak.

tools.description: Packs a bleeding area. Right click retrieves a packed sponge.
tools.misuseConsequence: A sponge left inside at closure is a never-event and fails the case.
